WiFi: the networks the board connects to, up to five.

Display: the brightness, and the language of every app.

Start: the app that starts when the board is switched on.

In any app, pull down from the top edge of the screen: the home button appears and takes you back to the menu.
Up to 5 networks, the most recently used first. Touch one to choose it.
The home menu of the board sets it before every app; an app can change it while it runs.
For every app of the board. An app takes it when it starts.
The apps of the menu of the board, not those of a folder such as Games. The home button of an app goes to the shell; at power-on a touch while the name of the app shows gives the shell too.

# SETTINGS: the WiFi networks that every Copper and Code app on this board uses.
#
# Up to five networks are kept by cac_settings in cac_settings.json in the flash, from the most
# recently used. boot.py connects to the best one in range at power-on; the other apps call
# cac_settings.connect() when they need the network. Here they are added, chosen, tried and
# forgotten. Scanning and connecting take seconds, so a touch only asks for them and the timer
# runs them on its next tick, after the screen has shown "Connecting...".
#
# Display also sets the language of the apps that speak more than one, in the section
# "general" of cac_settings.json. Start chooses the app that the home of the board starts at power-on instead of the shell,
# among the apps of its menu, /sd/home.json, kept in the section "home" of cac_settings.json.
import json
import sys

import cac_settings


# --- English and Italian, with the language chosen in the Settings app --------------------
IT = {
    'WiFi networks': 'Reti WiFi',

    'Display': 'Schermo',

    'Add a network': 'Aggiungi una rete',

    'Brightness 70%': "Luminosita' 70%",
    'The home menu of the board sets it before every app; an app can change it while it runs.': "Il menu della board la imposta prima di ogni app; un'app puo' cambiarla mentre funziona.",
    'Language': 'Lingua',
    'English\nItaliano': 'English\nItaliano',
    'For every app of the board. An app takes it when it starts.': "Per tutte le app della board. Un'app la prende quando parte.",
    'At power-on': "All'accensione",
    'At power-on: Forecast': "All'accensione: Forecast",

The home button of an app goes to the shell; at power-on a touch while the name of the app shows gives the shell too.': "Le app del menu della board, non quelle di una cartella come Giochi. La casetta di un'app porta alla shell; all'accensione la shell si ottiene anche toccando lo schermo mentre si vede il nome dell'app.",
    'No network saved: touch Add': 'Nessuna rete salvata: tocca Aggiungi',
    'No WiFi in the simulator: networks are saved only': 'Niente WiFi nel simulatore: le reti vengono solo salvate',
    'Connected to %s': 'Connesso a %s',
    'No WiFi in the simulator': 'Niente WiFi nel simulatore',

    'Could not connect to %s': 'Connessione a %s non riuscita',

    '%s: type the password': '%s: scrivi la password',

    'Touch a network first': 'Prima tocca una rete',

    'Brightness %d%%': "Luminosita' %d%%",

    'The app chosen is not in the menu: the shell starts': "L'app scelta non e' nel menu: parte la shell",

    'WiFi: no network yet, touch WiFi': 'WiFi: nessuna rete, tocca WiFi',
}
t = cac_settings.translator(IT)    # t("English text"): the text in the language of the board
_translated = False


def translate_once():
    """The texts of the pages, written in English in the designer, in the language of the board."""
    global _translated
    if not _translated:
        _translated = True
        cac_settings.translate(ui, IT)

UNSELECTED = 0x1B2838
SELECTED = 0x4FA3FF
DEFAULT_BRIGHTNESS = 70

sta = cac_settings.station()
job = None
selected = None             # the saved network chosen on Networks
picked = None               # the network chosen on Add
start_buttons = []          # (button, path, name) of the list on Start

MENU = "/sd/home.json"      # the menu of the board's home
DEMO_MENU = {"start": "/sd/apps/forecast/app_main.py", "apps": [
    {"name": "Settings", "path": "/sd/apps/settings/app_main.py"},
    {"name": "Forecast", "path": "/sd/apps/forecast/app_main.py"},
    {"name": "Photo Frame", "path": "/sd/apps/photo-frame/app_main.py"},
    {"name": "Games", "apps": [{"name": "Snake", "path": "/sd/apps/snake.py"}]}]}


def row_buttons():
    return (ui.net1, ui.net2, ui.net3, ui.net4, ui.net5)


def button_text(button, text):
    button.get_child(0).set_text(text)


def saved_names():
    return [n["ssid"] for n in cac_settings.networks()]


def show_networks():
    global selected
    saved = saved_names()
    if selected not in saved:
        selected = saved[0] if saved else None
    current = cac_settings.connected_ssid(sta)
    for i, button in enumerate(row_buttons()):
        if i < len(saved):
            name = saved[i]
            button_text(button, t("%s   connected") % name if name == current else name)
            button.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(SELECTED if name == selected else UNSELECTED), 0)
            button.remove_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
        else:
            button.add_flag(lv.obj.FLAG.HIDDEN)
    if not saved:
        ui.status.set_text(t("No network saved: touch Add"))
    elif sta is None:
        ui.status.set_text(t("No WiFi in the simulator: networks are saved only"))
    elif current:
        ui.status.set_text(t("Connected to %s") % current)
    else:
        ui.status.set_text(t("Not connected"))


def choose_row(index):
    global selected
    saved = saved_names()
    if index < len(saved):
        selected = saved[index]
        show_networks()


def forget_selected():
    global selected
    if selected:
        cac_settings.forget(selected)
        selected = None
    show_networks()


def start_connect():
    global job
    if not selected:
        return
    if sta is None:
        ui.status.set_text(t("No WiFi in the simulator"))
        return
    ui.status.set_text(t("Connecting to %s...") % selected)
    job = "connect"


def do_connect():
    secret = cac_settings.password(selected)
    if cac_settings.join(selected, secret, sta):
        cac_settings.remember(selected, secret)
        show_networks()
    else:
        ui.status.set_text(t("Could not connect to %s") % selected)


def open_add():
    global picked, job
    picked = None
    ui.password.set_text("")
    ui.keyboard.set_textarea(ui.password)
    ui.keyboard.set_align(lv.ALIGN.TOP_LEFT)    # a keyboard is aligned to the bottom by LVGL
    ui.keyboard.set_pos(0, lv.screen_active().get_height() - ui.keyboard.get_height())
    ui.scan_list.clean()
    ui.add_status.set_text(t("Looking for networks..."))
    job = "scan"


def start_scan():
    global job
    ui.add_status.set_text(t("Looking for networks..."))
    job = "scan"


def pick(name):
    global picked
    picked = name
    secret = cac_settings.password(name)
    ui.password.set_text(secret or "")
    ui.add_status.set_text((t("%s: saved, password filled in") if secret is not None else t("%s: type the password")) % name)


def do_scan():
    try:
        found = cac_settings.scan(sta)
    except OSError as e:
        print("scan:", repr(e))
        ui.add_status.set_text(t("WiFi not available"))
        return
    saved = saved_names()
    box = ui.scan_list
    box.clean()
    for name, rssi in found:
        b = lv.button(box)                     # the list lays its children out in a column
        b.set_size(lv.pct(100), 38)
        b.set_style_radius(4, 0)
        b.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(UNSELECTED), 0)
        label = lv.label(b)
        label.set_text(t("%s   saved") % name if name in saved else name)
        label.set_style_text_color(lv.color_hex(0xF2F5F9), 0)
        label.center()
        b.add_event_cb(lambda e, n=name: pick(n), lv.EVENT.CLICKED, None)
    ui.add_status.set_text(t("Touch a network") if found else t("No network in range"))


def start_save():
    global job
    if not picked:
        ui.add_status.set_text(t("Touch a network first"))
        return
    ui.add_status.set_text(t("Connecting to %s...") % picked)
    job = "save"


def do_save():
    global selected
    secret = ui.password.get_text()
    if sta is not None and not cac_settings.join(picked, secret, sta):
        ui.add_status.set_text(t("Could not connect: check the password"))
        return
    cac_settings.remember(picked, secret)
    selected = picked
    ui.load_page(ui.PAGE_NETWORKS)


def backlight(level):
    try:
        import display_driver
    except ImportError:
        return
    if hasattr(display_driver, "backlight"):          # the simulator has no backlight
        display_driver.backlight(level)


def show_brightness(level):
    ui.bright_text.set_text(t("Brightness %d%%") % level)


def open_display():
    level = cac_settings.section("display").get("brightness", DEFAULT_BRIGHTNESS)
    ui.bright.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(UNSELECTED), lv.PART.MAIN)    # the track, visible
    ui.bright.set_style_bg_opa(lv.OPA.COVER, lv.PART.MAIN)
    ui.bright.set_value(level, False)
    show_brightness(level)
    show_language()


LANGUAGES = ("en", "it")     # in the order of sel_lang


def show_language():
    code = cac_settings.section("general").get("language", "en")
    ui.sel_lang.set_selected(LANGUAGES.index(code) if code in LANGUAGES else 0)


def save_language():
    general = cac_settings.section("general")
    general["language"] = LANGUAGES[ui.sel_lang.get_selected()]
    cac_settings.set_section("general", general)


def change_brightness():
    level = ui.bright.get_value()
    show_brightness(level)
    backlight(level)


def save_brightness():
    """Written when the finger leaves the slider, not at every step: the flash wears out."""
    display = cac_settings.section("display")
    display["brightness"] = ui.bright.get_value()
    cac_settings.set_section("display", display)


def on_tick():
    global job
    current, job = job, None
    if current == "connect":
        do_connect()
    elif current == "scan":
        do_scan()
    elif current == "save":
        do_save()


def board_menu():
    """The menu of the board, /sd/home.json; in the simulator, which has no card, an example of it."""
    try:
        with open(MENU) as f:
            menu = json.load(f)
        return menu if isinstance(menu, dict) else {}
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return DEMO_MENU if sys.platform in ("linux", "darwin", "win32", "webassembly") else {}


def start_choices(menu):
    """The shell, then the apps of the first level of the menu: a folder, such as Games, is left out."""
    apps = [(a.get("name_" + cac_settings.language(), a["name"]), a["path"]) for a in menu.get("apps", []) if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("name") and isinstance(a.get("path"), str)]
    return [(t("Shell"), "")] + apps


def current_start(menu):
    """The path that starts at power-on: the choice made here, else the start of the menu; "" is the shell."""
    chosen = cac_settings.section("home")
    return chosen["start"] if "start" in chosen else (menu.get("start") or "")


def show_start():
    global start_buttons
    menu = board_menu()
    box = ui.start_list
    box.clean()
    start_buttons = []
    for name, path in start_choices(menu):
        b = lv.button(box)
        b.set_size(lv.pct(100), 42)
        b.set_style_radius(4, 0)
        label = lv.label(b)
        label.set_text(name)
        label.set_style_text_color(lv.color_hex(0xF2F5F9), 0)
        label.center()
        b.add_event_cb(lambda e, p=path: choose_start(p), lv.EVENT.CLICKED, None)
        start_buttons.append((b, path, name))
    mark_start(menu)


def mark_start(menu):
    """The colour of the chosen app, and its name above the list. The buttons stay: one of them may be in its own click."""
    current = current_start(menu)
    for b, path, _name in start_buttons:
        b.set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(SELECTED if path == current else UNSELECTED), 0)
    name = next((n for _b, p, n in start_buttons if p == current), None)
    if not menu:
        ui.start_status.set_text(t("No menu on the card: %s") % MENU)
    elif name is None:
        ui.start_status.set_text(t("The app chosen is not in the menu: the shell starts"))
    else:
        ui.start_status.set_text(t("At power-on: %s") % name)


def choose_start(path):
    home = cac_settings.section("home")
    home["start"] = path
    cac_settings.set_section("home", home)
    mark_start(board_menu())


def show_welcome():
    """What is set now: the WiFi, the language and the app of power-on."""
    saved = saved_names()
    current = cac_settings.connected_ssid(sta)
    if sta is None:
        wifi = t("WiFi: not in the simulator")
    elif current:
        wifi = t("WiFi: connected to %s") % current
    elif saved:
        wifi = t("WiFi: not connected, %d saved") % len(saved)
    else:
        wifi = t("WiFi: no network yet, touch WiFi")
    ui.welcome_wifi.set_text(wifi)
    ui.welcome_lang.set_text(t("Language: English") if cac_settings.language() == "en" else t("Language: Italiano"))
    menu = board_menu()
    current_path = current_start(menu)
    name = next((n for n, path in start_choices(menu) if path == current_path), None)
    ui.welcome_start.set_text(t("At power-on: %s") % (name or t("Shell")))
